name: Quartermaster

features.text: Configure category/item storage rules, priorities, presets and whole-furniture sections.
Sort inventory, containers, rooms, buildings and eligible floor items; shopping demands and Dibs lists.
Rooms integration and supply API used by Auto Clean.
physical shareable shopping papers and held-list HUD; paper supply inspections and ledger CDs.
PC Framework hosts Windows 93; Quartermaster registers the ledger reader and CD Writer app. Ledger freshness remains server-authoritative.
Carry grouping, progress, vehicle/trailer cargo and nested bags; optional Dangerous Load and extra carry allowance.
Sparse container/Whole/preset/room allocation profiles and percentage UI; bounded shadow accounting and reservation primitives. Enforcement and live role routing disabled.

Designated-room-only UI/server scopes with native building scope; retired native profiles stay dormant even through aliases. No-profile Shadow comparisons preserve ordinary native eligibility and capacity checks.
Required PC Framework 0.3.0-dev.1 owns bulky CRT art and retained drive/writer/app taskbar. Quartermaster reader revalidates cached resumes and supplies item/quantity/location table and details.

Portrait paper clipboard with a beveled spring clamp gripping the sheet, scroll-aligned ruling, separate selected-item details and resize grip with three-column ledger and page-turn controls. Server limits live computer statistics and automatic freshness to the exact recorded building; off-site/safehouse-wide CDs retain ordinary historical access. Supply Sheet creation requires a reusable vanilla clipboard and writing implement; one whole Notebook is consumed; no loose-page alternative.

Found Application CD runs SETUP.EXE via PC Framework CD program API 1. Server native-action completion installs per exact PC; guards digital reads/writes/automatic knowledge. Reusable disc, server prerequisite/time/loot settings; old ledger data preserved. CD loot targets commercial offices, office supply storage and computer stock; generic electronics/home desks/general cargo excluded.

Default SortUpdatesLedger: server building search prefers an accessible completed paper ledger, native pickup, otherwise carried blank/partial paper; requires pen/pencil and writes confirmed touched storage once after the full successful Sort. Existing CD generations and unvisited inspection timestamps are preserved. No inventory mutation by bookkeeping. Initial ledger creation consumes one whole Notebook; subsequent writing reuses the ledger.

limits: Native SP/dedicated NOT TESTED for 0.21.0-dev.2; G7/stable G8 BLOCKED. Requires separate PC Framework development source, which has no assigned Workshop item. Advisory allocation remains unenforced.

relations.text: Designated UUID geometry, metadata and independent action permissions; current storageScopes/roomDesignations contracts for advisory room profiles.
CD program API 1, desktop/device/server-drive host. Quartermaster owns installation receipts, native timing, ledger privacy/data and app callbacks.
